verdict.rationale: Kushki markets Smartlink as a first-party feature to create and customize payment links, which matches the core of the story. However, the only evidence is a one-line marketing headline: it does not show the links are made from a dashboard without code, that they are shareable, or that a founder can start selling right away. Missing for 10: documentation of no-code dashboard creation, link sharing and distribution, onboarding or time-to-first-sale details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
